name: Fixed Pagefile Size
description: Sets a fixed page file size based on your system's RAM to keep virtual memory behavior predictable.

description_i18n.en: Sets a fixed page file size based on your system's RAM to keep virtual memory behavior predictable.
description_i18n.de: Setzt eine feste Seitendateigröße basierend auf Ihrem Arbeitsspeicher für vorhersehbares virtülles Speicher-Verhalten.
description_i18n.fr: Définit une taille de fichier d'échange fixe basée sur la mémoire vive pour un comportement prévisible.

warnings.title: Manual configuration needed
warnings.message: This tweak sets a fixed size based on RAM limits. If you need custom sizes, manual registry editing is required

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The script disables automatic page file management and configures a fixed initial size equal to the maximum recommended limit for your installed RAM It targets Win32_PageFileSetting registry values
